speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Apricocks, now. The gardener binds them. She hears. He knows more than she.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not a parliament. A garden, and only the start of it. The cheese was twopence. The wheat can go in the book as itself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Evening prayer is done. The page is the next thing, and it is not a scene for a man to learn.
